_comment: When someone lists a general name ('butter', 'cheese', 'milk'), matching takes any ingredient ending in that name as a variety of it ('unsalted butter', 'parmesan cheese', 'whole milk') and says so in the result. These are the names that end the same way but are different foods, so they're never taken as varieties: listing 'cheese' doesn't mean having cream cheese. Matched against the end of an ingredient name, so 'nut butter' also covers 'smooth nut butter'. Add pairs as they come up.
